Primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC) is a chronic liver disease of unknown aetiology that develops due to progressive destruction of small and intermediate bile ducts within the liver, subsequently evolving to fibrosis and cirrhosis. Over 90% of patients are female, usually aged be- tween 40 and 60 years. The disease is thought to be auto-im- mune in nature.
